violations.why: After enable_isr(1), irq_quiver can preempt the task between the check at line 18 and the reset at line 19. Its addData() increments v_umber, so the reset can overwrite a value the check never saw.

irq_quiver runs enable_isr(2) at line 48, and the masking state is global. irq_raptor can then preempt the task between lines 18 and 19 and increment v_umber at line 30, which the write at line 19 then overwrites.
